description: Find possible address matches in county records from a partial query or misspelling. If the property is ambiguous, ask the user to choose before drawing conclusions or taking action. Similarity scores and is_auto_match are hints. They do not verify a selection, owner authority or financial eligibility.

limit.description: Maximum number of candidate suggestions to return (default: 5)

query.description: Address query or partial street name (e.g. '3731 Andrson Ave', 'Anderson Ave', '810 Lindsay')

name: suggest_addresses
